idea-plugin.name: Auto Commit
idea-plugin.description:
Auto Commit — generate Git commit messages with AI inside IntelliJ IDEA

AI Commit adds a one-click button to the IDEA Commit tool window that streams an AI-generated commit message into the message field, based on your staged changes. Works with any OpenAI-compatible API, including local models via Ollama or LM Studio.

Features

  • Built-in presets for OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, DeepSeek, Kimi (Moonshot), Zhipu GLM, Qwen DashScope, SiliconFlow, OpenRouter, Ollama, LM Studio, plus any custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
  • Conventional Commits / Gitmoji / Simple / fully custom system prompts.
  • Multilingual output: English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, or custom.
  • Streaming output directly into the commit message — stop anytime.
  • Right-click the ⚡ button to choose generation context: staged diff only, + file paths, or + recent commit history.
  • Auto-truncates large diffs, redacts secrets (.env, API keys), stores credentials in the system keychain (PasswordSafe).
  • Shortcut: ⌘⇧G (macOS) / Ctrl+Shift+G (Win/Linux).
  • Status-bar widget for quick provider / model switching.
  • No telemetry. Source on GitHub under MIT license.

中文简介

在 IDEA Commit 对话框里点 ⚡ 即可调用 AI 一键生成 commit message。 内置主流国内外模型预设，支持本地 Ollama / LM Studio；多 commit 规范与多语言； 大 diff 自动截断与脱敏；API Key 仅保存在系统 Keychain。
